name: Entity Import Plus
description: Add additional import plugins that are related to contributed modules.
project_description: Entity Import Plus is a submodule of Entity Import that adds migrate process plugins built on top of migrate_plus: Entity Lookup, Entity Generate, and String Replace. These make the parent module's point-and-click field mappings able to resolve inbound values to existing entity references, auto-create referenced entities that do not yet exist, and run search/replace (literal or regex) transformations during import. It also registers an event subscriber that seeds valid stub configuration for its migrate_plus-derived plugins so they instantiate cleanly inside Entity Import's dynamically built migrations.
